title: 第15章 妖圣白泽圣地蓬莱第16章 仙家坊市大巫九凤
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
洪荒之上，亦流传着一些“禁忌”。
比如，若有人背后喊你：道友请留步，便万万不可留步。
而现在这一句“小友请留步”则是让李玄霄顿感不安。
这声音虽然不高，却仿佛直接响在他的元神深处，尽管没有半分凶戾之气，却让他周身的遁光瞬间凝滞，就连风雷之力，都仿佛被这道声音定住了一般，再也无法向前挪动半分。
李玄霄心中一沉，知道自己躲不掉了。
既如此，便也转过身，对着声音传来的方向躬身行礼，语气恭敬：“晚辈截教李玄霄，路过此地，惊扰了前辈清修，还望前辈恕罪。晚辈这就绕道离开，绝不敢打扰前辈。”
话音落下，只见前方平静的海面上，缓缓浮现出一艘通体由星辰之精打造的舟船。
舟船不大，却萦绕着先天道韵，自带着一股古朴厚重的气息。
船舷两侧，站着数名妖族修士，皆是太乙金仙修为，气息沉稳，目光锐利，却恭敬地垂手而立，连头都不敢抬。
而舟船的船头，坐着一位身着素白道袍的修士。
他面容温润，须发皆白，眉宇间带着看透世事的平和与睿智，头顶生着一对玲珑的白角。
其周身没有半分威压外泄，却仿佛与这片天地融为一体，仿佛他就是这片海，这片天，世间万物的情状，都逃不过他的感知。
“不知前辈名号？”
只一眼，李玄霄的呼吸便微微一滞，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
眼前之人，竟有数尊太乙金仙的侍从。
其修为该是何等之高？
“妖族，白泽。”
白泽！
眼前之人，竟是天庭妖圣，白泽！
洪荒之中，谁人不知白泽之名？

这位乃是妖庭重臣！
妖帝帝俊、东皇太一座下的顶尖妖圣，天生能通万物情状，知天下鬼神之事，晓过去未来之理！
若是将妖族天庭众神排位，第一第二毫无争议当属帝俊、太一。
可这第三号人物，是那妖师鲲鹏，还是眼前这位妖圣白泽，就不好说了。
李玄霄怎么也没想到，自己只是外出赶路竟然会遇到这位传说中的妖圣白泽，且对方还将自己留下了。
“晚辈不知是白泽前辈在此，多有冒犯。”
“无妨。”
白泽轻轻摆了摆手，语气温和，没有半分架子，更没有半分为难之意，目光落在李玄霄身上，带着一丝淡淡的疑惑：“我不过是在此歇脚，避一避海上的风浪，倒是与小友有几分缘法。”
您这一尊准圣大能还要歇脚？还要避海上风浪？
李玄霄心中愈发警惕，更不敢多言，生怕言多必失。
可白泽见此只是淡淡一笑，继续道：“小友身上，既有截教上清仙韵，又具锐利剑意和先天风雷道蕴，虽修为尚低，却有个好根骨，日后当有不俗成就。更有趣的是……你不过真仙境界，但与我命中却有因果牵连。”
因果牵连？
与这位准圣大能？
李玄霄心中一凛，不过这白泽的神通便是关乎未来、人心，其所言应该不是空穴来风。
content_en:
There are also some "taboos" circulating in ancient times.
For example, if someone calls you from behind: "Fellow Taoist, please stay," then you must not stay.
But now the words "little friend, please stay" made Li Xuanxiao feel uneasy.
Although the voice was not high, it seemed to resound directly in the depths of his soul. Although it did not have any ferocious aura, it made the escape light around him instantly freeze. Even the power of wind and thunder seemed to be frozen by this voice, and could no longer move forward even half a minute.
Li Xuanxiao's heart sank, knowing that he couldn't hide.
That being the case, he turned around and bowed in the direction from which the voice came. He said in a respectful tone: "Jie Jie Li Xuanxiao, passed by this place and disturbed senior Qingxiu. I hope that senior will forgive me. I will take a detour and leave now. I will never dare to disturb senior."
As he finished speaking, he saw a boat made of the essence of the stars slowly emerging from the calm sea ahead.
The boat is not big, but it has the charm of innate Taoism lingering around it, and it has a simple and heavy atmosphere.
On both sides of the ship's side, stood several demon monks, all of whom were Taiyi Golden Immortals. They had a calm aura and sharp eyes, but they stood with their hands down respectfully, not even daring to raise their heads.
On the bow of the boat sat a monk wearing plain white robes.
He has a gentle face, white beard and hair, a look of peace and wisdom that sees through the world between his brows, and a pair of exquisite white horns on his head.
No pressure leaked from his body, but he seemed to be integrated with the world, as if he was the sea, the sky, and the conditions of all things in the world could not escape his perception.
"Don't you know your senior's name?"
With just one glance, Li Xuanxiao's breathing stagnated slightly, and a turmoil arose in his heart.
The people in front of me were actually several attendants of Taiyi Golden Immortal.
How high should its cultivation be?
"Demon clan, Bai Ze."
Baize!
The person in front of me is actually the Demon Saint of Heaven, Bai Ze!
Who in the wild doesn't know the name of Bai Ze?
This is an important minister of the Demon Court!
The top demon sage under Demon Emperor Jun and Donghuang Taiyi is born to understand the conditions of all things, know the affairs of ghosts and gods in the world, and know the principles of the past and the future!
If one were to rank the gods of the demon clan, the first and second place would undoubtedly be Di Jun and Tai Yi.
But it's hard to say whether this third figure is the Demon Master Kunpeng or the Demon Saint Bai Ze in front of him.
Li Xuanxiao never expected that he would meet the legendary demon saint Bai Ze when he was just going out for a trip, and he would even leave him behind.
"Junior didn't know it was Senior Bai Ze here, so it's very offensive."
"It doesn't matter."
Bai Ze waved his hand gently, his tone was gentle, without any arrogance or embarrassment. His eyes fell on Li Xuanxiao with a hint of doubt: "I'm just resting here to avoid the wind and waves on the sea, but I have some affinity with my little friend."
Do you, this quasi-sage, still want to rest? Want to avoid the waves at sea?
Li Xuanxiao became more and more vigilant and did not dare to say anything for fear that he would make mistakes if he spoke too much.
But Bai Ze just smiled faintly when he saw this and continued: "My little friend has the pure immortal charm of Jie Jiao, as well as the sharp sword intention and the innate wind and thunder Dao Yun. Although his cultivation level is still low, he has a good foundation and will have great achievements in the future. What's more interesting is... you are not in the realm of true immortals, but you are causally involved in my fate."
Cause and effect implication?
With this quasi-sage?
Li Xuanxiao was shocked, but Bai Ze's magical power was related to the future and people's hearts, so what he said was probably not groundless.
